content.introduction: The United States economic indicators as of July/26 show Business Confidence at 55.6 points, Manufacturing PMI at 53.9 points, Non Manufacturing PMI at 54.1 points, Services PMI at 54.6 points, Composite PMI at 54.5 points, and Industrial Production at 1.1 percent. Consumer Confidence was 51 points in August/26, and Retail Sales MoM was -0.6 percent in July/26. The sources do not provide a definitive answer for some indicators like Government Budget and Gross Fixed Capital Formation for the latest month.
